note: Quality-control rules for live station readings, read by scripts/obs-qc.mjs (realtime.json) and scripts/obs_qc.py (metar.json); the two implementations are tested against the same vectors (test/fixtures/qc-vectors.json). 'range' limits are world records (WMO Archive of Weather and Climate Extremes, wmo.asu.cornell.edu), so they only catch impossible values. Every other number is a screening convention of this portal, not a published threshold, and is calibrated so that only gross errors are flagged. Flagged readings stay in the data files, marked in each station's `qc`, and are left out of the live bias curve and the Barnes analysis.

temperature.range_source: world record low (Vostok, 1983) and high (Death Valley, 1913)

dew_point.range_source: physical bound: dew point cannot exceed the air temperature; 40 degC is above any surface value on record

pressure.range_source: world record sea-level pressure 870 and 1084.8 hPa (Tropical Cyclone Tip 1979, Agata 1968); 300 hPa is a station above 9 km

rain_rate.range_source: world record 31.2 mm in one minute (Unionville, 1956)

limits: Not covered: wind and rain neighbourhood tests, humidity and pressure stuck tests (calm and steady air are legitimate), the stuck test for METAR (hourly integers repeat legitimately).
